title: ICON2: Reliably Benchmarking Predictive Inequity in Object Detection by Identifying and Controlling for Confounders
findings: The paper does not analyze or contain any findings related to religion. Its focus is on identifying and controlling for confounding variables (like object size, occlusion, weather) when measuring performance disparities across different income levels in autonomous driving datasets.
